name: [2X🍀] The Cul De Sac RPG
desc:
🌳 Cul de Sac is a whimsical RPG adventure filled with exploration, random events, strange creatures, powerful bosses, and satisfying progression.

✨ Explore a whimsical world full of secrets
🎣 Fish, mine, catch, and gather rare resources
⚔️ Unlock massive abilities and powerful gear
🌟 Meet lovable NPCs and uncover their stories
💎 Discover rare drops and craft powerful upgrades

🎉 Join the journey
💬 Your feedback helps shape the world
🔔 Follow for updates and new content

📢 Join the community for news, tips, and sneak peeks!
